research_questions: Where does instruction-conditioned behavior first fail across the four-stage chain?
Does a minimal deployable repair improve held-out L1/L2 behavior while retaining L0?
system_boundary: SmolVLA evaluator observation→policy→action→env.step→success; oracle inputs are diagnostic-only.

operational_definitions.observation: batched float32 image/state tensors plus task string passed to policy.select_action
operational_definitions.action: first batch row returned by policy.select_action and passed to env.step
operational_definitions.success: done and is_success_done, with safety cost threshold when enabled
operational_definitions.failure: episode ends, times out, or raises without satisfying success

stopping_rule: run frozen manifest; do not add trials after viewing results
primary_measure: paired success transition and success-rate delta
analysis_plan: Wilson intervals, paired effect, exact McNemar, frozen missing-data rules
resource_plan: Report planned/attempted/completed/failed/not-run, wall time, GPU-hours, peak memory and estimated cost.
boundary: No formal checkpoints or evaluator records are present; no performance claim is permitted.
